Class Bugemon

java.lang.Object
models.bugemon.Bugemon
All Implemented Interfaces:
BugemonDTO
public class Bugemon extends Object implements BugemonDTO
Represents a Bugémon with its stats, attacks and sprite. Implements BugemonDTO to expose read-only data to views. Fields are populated via Gson deserialization or the copy constructor.
